title: The 'Add Asset' button in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders Create & Edit ON, Customers View ON and Customers Create & Edit OFF.
steps:
1. Log in and click New Work Order.
  2. Select an existing customer.
  3. Go to the asset/vehicle step.
  4. Look for an Add Asset button in the asset picker.
expected:
The Add Asset button IS shown, and adding a new asset for the customer from the New Work Order flow works.

Adding an asset here is part of creating a work order (Work Orders: Create & Edit). It does NOT require Customers: Create & Edit.
